mechanics.normalIngredient: recipe use = U/100; Cooking reduces source use by 3% per level; nutrition transfer is source nutrition × used fraction × (1 + Cooking/15).
mechanics.spice: Spices do not add normal dish hunger; they can add nutrition, use the same Cooking nutrition multiplier, and cannot be duplicated.
mechanics.rotten: Rotten evolved ingredients require Cooking 7+. At Cooking 7-8 the requested use is based on 5% of base hunger; at 9-10 it is 10%.
mechanics.frozen: Supplied B42.20 evolved recipes do not set AllowFrozenItem, so frozen source foods are rejected.
mechanics.burnt: Burnt source foods are rejected from evolved-recipe additions.
mechanics.base: When an evolved result is created, Food bases pass their hunger/macros/thirst into the result. Non-food container bases start those values at zero.
